We live surrounded by people, other living beings and ae

nature. Things keep happening in this world! Sometimes

COLD

the weather is hot, sometimes its cold or rainy or windy!

Like the outside weather, our
world of feelings also keeps
changing! It depends on what is
happening inside the body and
what’s happening outside. When
we fall down and get hurt, we feel
pain. What if there was no pain?
We would not even know we have
hurt ourselves! Pain draws our
attention to the part that is hurt
so that we can take care of it.

Make groups of 4:
Discuss what if there
were no feelings?
What would happen
then?

Feelings bring
a positive
change in me.

There is another world
inside us. It is made up of
feelings. We feel happy,
sad, angry, upset, irritated,
sleepy, tired, bored... the list
goes on! a2

Think of 3 feelings.
How do they help you?
Write below:

Think and Do:

Do you think animals have
feelings? Why do you think so?
What about plants?
